text: Taking the trace of the Einstein field equations shows that the effective gravitational source for a perfect fluid in GR is:
choices: the energy density ε alone, exactly as in Newtonian gravity
ε + 3p, so that pressure contributes positively to gravity
explanation: The trace of G_μν = 8πG T_μν/c⁴ reveals that gravity for a perfect fluid is sourced by ε + 3p, not by ε (or ρ) alone — in GR, pressure gravitates. This is why the very pressure that supports a neutron star also adds to its gravitational pull, as captured by the Tolman-Oppenheimer-Volkoff equation. The purely Newtonian view that only the density sources the field is the misconception the book warns against.
